title: LC-MS/MS Untargeted Metabolomics
author: Kevin Contrepois
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bf4ujqww
materials: Thermo Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer

Data were acquired on a Thermo Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer for HILIC (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Bremen, Germany) and a Thermo Q Exactive mass spectrometer for RPLC (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Bremen, Germany).

HILIC experiments were performed using a ZIC-HILIC column 2.1 x 100 mm, 3.5 μm, 200Å (Merck Millipore, Darmstadt, Germany) and mobile phase solvents consisting of 10 mM ammonium acetate in 50/50 acetonitrile/water (A) and 10 mM ammonium acetate in 95/5 acetonitrile/water (B).

steps.title: Prepare LC-MS System
steps.instruction: Equilibrate the LC-MS system by injecting pool samples prior to running the sequence.

steps.title: Configure RPLC Parameters
steps.instruction: Set up the RPLC system using the specified column and mobile phases.

substeps.instruction: Use a Zorbax SBaq column (2.1 x 50 mm, 1.7 μm, 100Å)
Prepare mobile phase A: 0.06% acetic acid in water
Prepare mobile phase B: 0.06% acetic acid in methanol

steps.title: Perform Untargeted Metabolomics Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze metabolic extracts using a combination of HILIC and RPLC separation.

substeps.instruction: Analyze extracts four times using both positive and negative ionization modes
Equip instruments with a HESI-II probe
Operate instruments in full MS scan mode

steps.title: Acquire MS/MS Data
steps.instruction: Acquire MS/MS data on quality control (QC) samples.

substeps.instruction: Use an equimolar mixture of all samples in the study for the QC samples

steps.title: Ensure Data Quality
steps.instruction: Implement quality control measures throughout the injection sequence.

substeps.instruction: Inject a pool sample every 10 injections to control for signal deviation over time
Verify mass accuracy, retention time, and peak shape of internal standards in each sample
